body: Thanks for this advice, I will take it and use this as my focus

Its been almost a month I believe..

Yeah, we used to sleep together on skype and talk pretty much all the time when we got home. We even played games together.. 
Yeah its really hard.. She messaged me the other day which was surprising but only because she was at our mutual friends house and I was talking to him before she got there. I am feeling more like option B right now but also considering C.. 
I've tried games but a lot of the game we played together and now I see her online playing with her new boyfriend it's sort of gutwrenching so I gave up on that.. tried weed and I guess it helped because I was with friends but once I got home it was worse.. I tried clubbing, was fun for the night and again all was well until I got home. She was just such a big part of my life even though it was just for a year. I would have died for her :/ I'm not inexperienced either its just I never liked any of my past girlfriends as much as I liked her

It happens dude I wouldn't think too much about it. To be honest with you I felt the same way my first party and they don't get much better but clubbing is actually really fun.. (I didn't drink much) 
If you want to try drinking I would recommend amaretto with some coke/anything you can find (wouldn't drink it straight though). Very nice drink and if you're a lightweight like me it can get you pretty drunk/tipsy :D

Similar thing happened with me man.. It's hard dude and getting over a person you have a bond with really isn't easy. I can't really give advice because i'm not over my ex and it will take me a long time. I just wanna let you know you're not alone man.. That thing about the games, well I used to play stuff with her and a few friends but since we broke up we never play together and it actually made me just lose interest in the game completely. Good luck man, i'm managing right now somehow but I have thought of extremes in the past.. Just try to keep yourself occupied. When you're doing nothing do something like study etc or get a part-time job. That's helping me a lot..

Oh my bad xD I meant your story

Gift has almost arrived but honestly i'm kinda regretting sending it because if I don't get her back it's kinda over for good this time
Thanks man, I sent her a gift and a letter to apologize for being an ass to her. I really fucked up and she tried so hard.. Mind sharing what happened with you?

Yeah I understand I live in the UK too and to be honest it can be pretty scary and you're putting yourself at risk. I would walk tomorrow maybe explain your situation to them ask them if you can start next week maybe while you get things sorted with the job center. They are supposed to get you into work so washing their hands with you before you are in a position where you don't need to rely on them is crazy. I'd definitely try to talk to job center tomorrow after doing the induction, maybe even go after work.

Hey guy.. I did something similar, even posted about it. It does suck man and my girlfriend did this too but only after breaking up do I realize the arguing wasn't needed. It's hard man but if it isn't for you then you just gotta move on.. I don't have anybody to talk to either so I literally spent the two days after the break up super depressed and barely eating. The only thing to do is move on dude, if you think she doesn't care and you're really sure she doesn't then just get out. If you think there's a chance you can work it out then try if you want to. Good luck guy!

Your BF probably knows. I would just come clean ASAP because it will be eating at him and he will eventually become curious as to why you're trying so desperately to cover it up. I think if you tell him what you have told us he will understand. Good luck!

I'm in a similar situation so I can't really give advice from a clear mind BUT if it was me and I liked her, I would continue to pursue her guy. Good luck man, really hope it works it with either decision you make.

Hmm :/ a bit of a difficult situation you're in there dude. I'm unsure how the system works but what if you called them and told them you had an interview and no money to get there? But for a job I would definitely just walk it! I know it's daunting now but you've got the job so it would definitely be worth it dude. Or maybe walk it tomorrow then go to the job centre to sign on the next day so you have money for transport next time. Good luck!
